title: Tonopah S4 workers flown in by Janet
summary: UAPGerb tells of Tonopah S4 workers flown in by Janet, about present at Tonopah Test Range, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: employees on the S4 area of Tonipa test range have to be taken there directly from Janet and cannot drive on site like other employees at Tonipa can.

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, passed on something he learned from a source connected to the Lazy G Ranch in Nevada. He says that workers at an area called S4 on the Tonopah Test Range, a secretive military testing ground in Nevada, must be flown straight there on Janet, the unmarked airline that carries staff to secret Nevada sites, and are not allowed to drive in like other Tonopah employees. If true, it would mean S4 is guarded even more tightly than the rest of an already secret base.
